principles.title: LaTeX is the final source of truth
principles.summary: Markdown and AI responses are planning artifacts. Final contest deliverables are built from paper/main.tex and modular LaTeX sections.

principles.title: Evidence before prose polish
principles.summary: Important claims must connect to result, figure, source, or claim ledgers before writing/polishing skills touch the final paper.

principles.title: MCP is a tool layer, not the product brain
principles.summary: MCP servers expose scoped tools/resources/prompts. Product state, gates, and artifact ownership stay in local files and paperctl.

principles.title: Skills are reviewed advice modules
principles.summary: External skills are discovered and evaluated before installation. They must not override local evidence discipline or invent results.

principles.title: Workflow blueprint drives the product
principles.summary: The product should expose stage-specific lanes, recommended skills, MCP capabilities, required outputs, and gates instead of relying on ad-hoc prompting.

external_sources.title: OpenAI Chat Completions API
external_sources.summary: OpenAI-compatible providers expose chat completion endpoints driven by model, messages, API key, and generation parameters.

external_sources.title: Model Context Protocol Architecture
external_sources.summary: MCP separates hosts, clients, and servers, with servers exposing tools, resources, and prompts to applications.

external_sources.title: Model Context Protocol Specification Architecture
external_sources.summary: The protocol specification describes MCP as a client-host-server architecture built on JSON-RPC with resources, tools, and prompts as core primitives.

external_sources.title: Claude Code Skills
external_sources.summary: Skills use SKILL.md instructions plus optional supporting assets that are loaded when relevant to a task.

external_sources.title: Nature Research Figure Guide
external_sources.summary: Research figures should communicate evidence clearly through readable axes, clean panels, appropriate export formats, and purposeful captions.

external_sources.title: skills.sh scientific visualization candidates
external_sources.summary: The skills.sh catalog includes scientific-visualization and related plotting/data-analysis skills that can be reviewed before adding external figure workflows.

external_sources.title: COMAP MCM/ICM Instructions
external_sources.summary: Contest rules and submission requirements are year-sensitive and must be refreshed before each contest run.

external_sources.title: CUMCM Official Site
external_sources.summary: CUMCM rules and format requirements should be treated as authoritative for Chinese mathematical modeling contest submissions.

external_sources.title: skills.sh Skill Catalog
external_sources.summary: Open skills catalog searched through npx skills find; candidates must be reviewed before installation.

stage_gates.evidence: Every subquestion has a direct-answer target and data dependency.
stage_gates.next: Run stage-prompt or run-stage intake, then update problem-map and modeling-plan.

stage_gates.evidence: Each key result has a script, source data, metric, value, and unit.
stage_gates.next: Write/review modeling scripts, run them, and update result-ledger.

stage_gates.evidence: Each finished figure has a purpose, source data, script, caption claim, and LaTeX reference.
stage_gates.next: Generate evidence-focused plots and register them in figure-ledger.

stage_gates.evidence: Important claims in LaTeX are linked to result, figure, or source evidence.
stage_gates.next: Draft/revise LaTeX sections using only verified evidence.

stage_gates.evidence: paperctl verify has no FAIL items and latexmk produces paper/main.pdf.
stage_gates.next: Run verify, build, inspect WARN items, then package deliverables.
